newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha supported by steady buying interest.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha supported by steady buying interest.

text.p: European naphtha markets were steady to slightly firmer in quiet trade on Monday.
Steady petrochemical buying interest continued to underpin prices, with high paraffinic barrels in thin supply and valued around benchmark quotes cif high +$5 a tonne cif NWE.
Poor reforming margins for gasoline saw N+A and full range material talked $2.50 under this level.

"There's a lot of full range material but much of it won't meet the paraffinic spec requirements," a trader said Trader buying for pipeline spec also persisted, with bids heard up to $218 cif NWE, but offers were scarce.
